# Ruler Square

> Free calculators for US building materials, home project costs. Each calculator shows its formula, a worked example and the assumptions behind the default values, so a result can be checked rather than taken on trust. Quantities round up, never to nearest, because running short mid-job costs more than ordering long. Independent and maintained by one person, Știuriuc Sorin-Marian; no accounts, and calculator inputs stay in the browser.

## Citation

Results, formulas and short explanations may be quoted with attribution and a link to the relevant page. Densities, coverage rates and cost ranges are planning assumptions with their sources listed on each page; they are not supplier quotes or engineering specifications. How every calculator works, and where each figure comes from: https://rulersquare.com/methodology/

## Calculators by category

- [Construction calculators](https://rulersquare.com/construction-calculators/): concrete, asphalt, framing, stairs, roofing, drywall, tile, siding, brick, rebar and unit conversions
- [Landscaping calculators](https://rulersquare.com/landscaping-calculators/): gravel, crushed stone, sand, topsoil, fill dirt, mulch, river rock, sod, pavers and retaining walls
- [Project cost calculators](https://rulersquare.com/cost-calculators/): installed budgets for concrete slabs, patios, driveways, decks, fences, retaining walls and roof replacement

## Most used

- [Concrete Calculator](https://rulersquare.com/concrete-calculator/): cubic yards, 40–80 lb bags and cost for slabs, footings, columns and round pads
- [Gravel Calculator](https://rulersquare.com/gravel-calculator/): tons and cubic yards by area and depth, with an editable density
- [Crushed Stone Calculator](https://rulersquare.com/stone-calculator/): #57 stone and crusher run in tons and yards
- [Mulch Calculator](https://rulersquare.com/mulch-calculator/): cubic yards and bags for beds
- [Square Footage Calculator](https://rulersquare.com/square-footage-calculator/): rectangles, circles, triangles and trapezoids, summed across sections
